# Effects on human milk nutrient deficiency

Relative risks (RRs) of nutrient deficiency, pooled intervention vs. control, estimated by TMLE within each trial and visit. A sample is deficient when its concentration is below the 10th percentile of the age-specific reference distribution from the Mothers, Infants, and Lactation Quality (MILQ) study; RR < 1 means less deficiency with the intervention. `nY` of `N` samples were deficient. Components with fewer than five deficient samples in a trial and visit were not analyzed. *Q* (`pval_adj`) is FDR-adjusted within visit and outcome group.

```{r milq-table, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(dplyr); library(here) })
source(here::here("functions.R"))
milq_df <- safe_readRDS(here::here("figure-data/fig-milq-deficiency-reduction-data.RDS"),
                        label = "fig-milq-deficiency-reduction-data.RDS")
if (!is.null(milq_df) && is.data.frame(milq_df)) {
  out <- milq_df %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(visit = visit_name(study, visit), study = study_name(study),
                  label_f = canonical_label(biomarker, label_f)) %>%
    dplyr::select(dplyr::any_of(c(
      "study","visit","contrast","category","label_f",
      "N","nY","RR","ci.lb","ci.ub","pvalue","pval_adj","sig","sigFDR"
    ))) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(where(is.numeric), ~ signif(.x, 3)))
  nice_dt(out, caption = "Relative risks of deficiency, pooled intervention vs. control.")
}
```
